caption: The drawing depicts a single, scalloped-edged bowl placed centrally within a lightly outlined square on a beige or off-white background. The bowl has a fluted exterior with vertical grooves and is colored in varying shades of brown and reddish-brown, with some lighter highlights suggesting reflections on its glossy surface. The base of the bowl is small and circular, while the body widens outwards and upwards, ending in a gently flared rim. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small technical diagram of the bowl, showing its cross-sectional profile with dimensions marked in pencil or ink, and colored in a light orange or pink. The main drawing and the diagram are both enclosed within fine pencil lines that outline the composition.
title: Mold
